answer: Counterparty-diversity threshold stops one operator running fake identities that trade with each other. An agent must work for 12 unrelated counterparties, none above 20%: an opal cutter selling to its clones fails. A log flags overlap, so a jetty crew serving one fleet is paused. 100 fakes need 1,200 relationships at 5 credits each, 6,000 credits, versus 60 for an honest agent. A violet grower with many buyers passes, keeping undiluted rewards.
